    • serialVersionUID

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • geospatialUpperLeft

      public PointGeospatial geospatialUpperLeft
      Geospatial point that corresponds to the upper left corner of the geospatial area display. This parameter, along with pointsPerRadianLatitude and pointsPerRadianLongitude below, is used to translate all geospatial points (lats/lons) to cartesian points (X/Y) in the area display.

    • pointsPerRadianLatitude

      public RReal pointsPerRadianLatitude
      Value of the number of X,Y points (XYDatas) in a radian of latitude. This parameter, along with geospatialUpperLeft is used to translate all geospatial points (lats/lons) to cartesian points (X/Y) in the area display.

    • pointsPerRadianLongitude

      public RReal pointsPerRadianLongitude
      Value of the number of X,Y points (XYDatas) in a radian of longitude. Note this is a derived value and, along with geospatialUpperLeft is used to translate all geospatial points (lats/lons) to cartesian points (X/Y) in the area display.

    • kilometersPerMile

      public static RReal kilometersPerMile
      Value for converting miles to kilometers

    • pointsCartesianPerKilometer

      public RReal pointsCartesianPerKilometer
